MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The wired earbuds with a microphone connect to my past headset purchase because they serve a similar listening and calling purpose, though I would only consider them if I needed a replacement."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Streaming sticks, a smart speaker and a smart plug do not solve the computer connection needs reflected in my purchases.",
    "Buying a DVI cable does not mean I need an HDMI cable; the connection my equipment actually uses matters.",
    "A tablet mount suggests I wanted to use an existing tablet, not buy another tablet or expand its storage."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations treat interest in a few electronic accessories as interest in electronic devices generally.",
    "Several streaming devices repeat an assumption that I want TV entertainment equipment, which my history does not support."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent purchase addressed wired network connectivity, and earlier purchases also involved specific computer ports and connections.",
    "My purchases are spread far apart and appear tied to particular equipment needs; a related accessory alone is not enough to make me act now.",
    "Compatibility and the problem an accessory solves matter more to me than its being broadly related to something I already own."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized a broad interest in electronics but missed my occasional, specific need for compatible computer accessories."
}
